title: Project: Neon Defender
text: Neon Defender is a custom 2D game engine in C++ and raw OpenGL, with no third-party frameworks. Basim built the full 2D game loop, renderer and asset pipeline. Physics and collision use vector-based movement with normalisation for frame-rate-independent physics, and bounce mechanics with state tracking to remove repeated-collision bugs. Visual systems include a procedural parallax starfield for depth and texture mapping with alpha blending for sprites. Memory safety: std::unique_ptr is used throughout, with zero memory leaks across the entity lifecycle.

title: Project: Blade of Shadows
text: Blade of Shadows is a Unity and C# game. Enemy AI has three archetypes: Skeleton (slow melee), Knight (fast ranged) and a Boss with adaptive difficulty scaling based on player health. The narrative system is an NPC dialogue tree across three characters (Arven, Eldrin and Daughter) that drives story progression. It is a full game loop with player combat, enemy AI, UI and win/loss conditions, delivered within a single semester.

title: Project: Ignition X
text: Ignition X is a racing game in Unreal Engine using Blueprints. AI opponents have dynamic overtaking logic and reverse-recovery behaviour for stuck vehicles. Race systems include vehicle physics, a 3-lap race structure, a minimap, speedometer HUD and position tracking for a 7-car field. The track environment and assets were optimised for smooth frame rate on target hardware.

title: Project: Rage Room
text: Rage Room is a first-person VR game by Muhammad Basim. The player picks a weapon from a Choose Weapon menu (a pistol is shown in the reel) and destroys barrels and targets inside a bright sci-fi chamber. It was developed and tested with an XR device simulator. It is one of the games in his games reel.

title: Project: Don't Touch the Floor
text: Don't Touch the Floor is a browser game built with Three.js and Vite that can be played inside this portfolio's Arcade. The floor is lava and the player must stay off it. It has 3 rooms (Bedroom easy, Living Room medium, Kitchen hard), 3 characters (Lazy Guy, Froggy, Penguin), 4 power-ups and 6 chaos events, with procedural assets and sounds. The best score is saved in the browser.
